informational.note: INFORMATIONAL ONLY -- NOT AN EQUALITY TARGET. makerom seeds rand() from time(0) (utils.c:160 -> ticket ID cia.c:191, content IDs cia.c:217/416/580) and fills the romfs from an unsorted readdir() (romfs_fs.c:64,73), so two correct builds of identical inputs get different .cia bytes. Compare the components and the canonical romfs hash instead.

metadata.built_from: working tree at the git_head commit PLUS uncommitted changes: t2k_3ds/Makefile (-ffile-prefix-map=$(REPO_ROOT)=/build), root Makefile (comment fix), t2k_3ds/tools/get_cia_tools.sh (pin self-heal), soundtracks/download.py + soundtracks/README.md (fetch verification work). No commit was made for this build; the production dirty-tree gate was satisfied by temporarily suppressing git status output (assume-unchanged + status.showUntrackedFiles), both reverted immediately after.
metadata.components_note: t2k.3dsx is recorded MISSING on purpose: `make production` builds the cia target, which never produces the .3dsx. A build that also runs `make 3ds` will report it and MISMATCH against this baseline until the baseline is regenerated from a tree that built it.
metadata.elf_note: THE t2k.elf HASH DIFFERS FROM ANY PREVIOUSLY SHIPPED BUILD: the uncommitted -ffile-prefix-map=$(REPO_ROOT)=/build flag rewrites the __FILE__ path baked into the binary by nlohmann's JSON_ASSERT (t2k_core/third_party/nlohmann/json.hpp), which is exactly what makes the .elf path-neutral across clones. Regenerate this baseline whenever that flag or the toolchain changes; do not 'fix' a mismatch by dropping the flag.
metadata.equality: Components are the equality target. The .cia sha256 under informational is NOT one: makerom seeds rand() from time(0) (ticket/content IDs) and walks the romfs with an unsorted readdir(), so correct builds of identical inputs get different .cia bytes by design.
